ABOUT

/About the company

Auttimo, Italian for "optimal", brings mobile car wash and detailing to customers' homes, offices, hotels and golf courses, with a focus on European craftsmanship.

Its partners are accredited owner-operators, each carrying $1M in liability insurance. Services cover mobile car wash, auto detailing, paint correction and ceramic coating.

Auttimo is part of the Ultrabrands Company group, the same group as Jim's Mowing BC. I joined while the brand was still a startup.

SCOPE

/My role & scope

For 14 months I was Auttimo's lead digital marketer, working full-time and remotely. While the brand was still a startup, I built its content library, its website visuals and its logo.

  • Crafted and optimized 150 SEO-focused articles and multimedia content
  • Published the articles on the Auttimo Customer Blog in WordPress
  • Covered ceramic coating, paint protection film, paint correction, interior detailing and exotic car care
  • Bought and selected the Shutterstock photos used across the blog and site
  • Edited and optimized images in Adobe Photoshop and Canva
  • Kept a consistent, premium look that suits an exotic car brand
  • Created AI graphics with ChatGPT and Gemini
  • Edited video for the digital marketing campaigns in Adobe Premiere Pro and CapCut
  • Designed service banners, like the Ceramic Coating banner
  • Made website updates and published content in WordPress
  • Designed the Auttimo logo around one idea: premium
  • Took it from an early red, blue and white version to the final green, white and red wordmark
